title: Counterfactual Oversight Probing: What Would the Model Have Done Without the Overseer Signal?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear chain: measuring the counterfactual effect of oversight is the true safety-relevant metric. If oversight does not change behavior, it is not providing value. This is a fundamental evaluation question.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires training the same model in two conditions (with and without oversight), which means running two separate fine-tuning pipelines. The training requirement is substantial for beginners with medium compute.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Two parallel training runs and behavioral comparison. Each training run is a project in itself. Controlling for confounders between the two conditions adds complexity. Hard to fit in 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
